_about: Step 4d (the orchestrator's 5 Oct addition; decision 40, rule G27): the clinic's word and line text as the language engine's own source. It used to live in data/clinic/lang.json (now deleted: all of it is here, under `lang`) and in data/clinic.json (each word's Kutchi, English, gender and sources; each tray item's English and its Cook word; each line's English). build/lang/import_clinic.mjs reads it here; the clinic's code reads none of it (js/clinic/lang.js asks the engine). data/clinic.json keeps the ids and the non-language fields (groups, sides, glyphs, colours, a line's meaning). data/clinic/pipeline.json's English words stay where they are for now: the clinic's code still reads them for its result rows and aria-labels (a js/clinic change, the clinic owner's).

lang._about: The clinic's words and sentence frames for the language seam (js/core/lang through the clinic's source, js/clinic/lang.js). R5 moved every Kutchi word, number table and join (pela / ne poi / ne, wadho / nindho) out of the clinic's code into this file. Nothing here is new Kutchi: words that Cook already has keep Cook's id and entry (from: data/cook.json), the rest were string literals in js/clinic and say where. A word with kutchi: null is an English placeholder (grey italic, flagged to record). Describing words and 'one' agree with the noun's gender; a noun of unknown gender takes the he-form, flagged 'to check' (decision 21). The frames here have no full stop (card rows: F10).
